component.name: Stepper
component.description: Tab-structured step navigation with configurable orientation and separator layout.

slots.name: root
slots.description: Stepper container that owns orientation, step state, and panel rendering.

slots.name: header
slots.description: Step navigation header that contains all step triggers.

slots.name: container
slots.description: Text column inside a step trigger.

slots.name: trigger
slots.description: Interactive step control users activate to select a step.

slots.name: indicator
slots.description: Step marker that communicates index, active state, or completion.

slots.name: icon
slots.description: Icon rendered inside a completed or custom step indicator.

slots.name: wrapper
slots.description: Inner layout wrapper for a single step trigger.

slots.name: title
slots.description: Primary title text for a step.

slots.name: content
slots.description: Panel rendered for the active step content.

own.name: activationMode
own.description: Whether keyboard activation happens immediately or only after confirmation.

own.name: class
own.description: Class applied to the component root element.

own.name: clickable
own.description: Whether steps are clickable for navigation.

own.name: defaultValue
own.description: Default active step value for uncontrolled usage.

own.name: disabled
own.description: Whether the entire stepper is disabled.

own.name: id
own.description: Unique identifier for the stepper root element.

own.name: linear
own.description: Whether to enforce linear navigation (must complete steps in order).

own.name: onChange
own.description: Callback when the active step changes.

props.name: class
props.description: Additional class name for the step item.

props.name: content
props.description: Content to display when the step is active.

props.name: icon
props.description: Icon to display in the step indicator.

item.description: An individual step in the stepper.
